# Libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(scales)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
```

# Load Data
```{r}
univExpenses <- read.csv("../Data/Raw/Expenses_All_Sports_and_Men_s_Women_s_and_Coed_Teams_2023.csv")
univFinance  <- read.csv("../Data/Raw/f2223_f1a_rv.csv")
univGrad     <- read.csv("../Data/Raw/gr2023_RV.csv")
```

# Clean Data
```{r}
univExpensesCleaned <- univExpenses %>%
  select(UNITID, Classification.Name, Grand.Total.Expenses, Institution.Name) %>%
  mutate(sportsExpenses = Grand.Total.Expenses) %>%
  select(-Grand.Total.Expenses)

univFinanceCleaned <- univFinance %>%
  select(UNITID, F1C191) %>%
  mutate(totalExp = F1C191) %>%
  select(-F1C191)

univGradCleaned <- univGrad %>%
  filter(GRTYPE %in% c(8, 9)) %>%
  select(UNITID, GRTYPE, GRTOTLT) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = GRTYPE,
              values_from = GRTOTLT,
              names_prefix = "grtype_") %>%
  rename(cohortSize = grtype_8, completed = grtype_9)

univData <- univExpensesCleaned %>%
  inner_join(univFinanceCleaned, by = "UNITID") %>%
  inner_join(univGradCleaned, by = "UNITID") %>%
  mutate(gradRate = completed / cohortSize,
         spendRate = sportsExpenses / totalExp) %>%
  filter(grepl("^NCAA", Classification.Name)) %>%
  mutate(division = case_when(
    Classification.Name == "NCAA Division I-FBS" ~ "D-I FBS",
    Classification.Name == "NCAA Division I-FCS" ~ "D-I FCS",
    Classification.Name == "NCAA Division I without football" ~ "D-I no football",
    grepl("Division II\\b", Classification.Name) ~ "D-II",
    grepl("Division III", Classification.Name) ~ "D-III"
  ))

  univData <- univData %>%
  rename(ClassificationName = Classification.Name,
         InstitutionName = Institution.Name)

write_csv(univData, "../Data/Clean/univData.csv")

```

# EDA
```{r}
univData %>%
  group_by(division) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_spend = mean(spendRate),
    median_spend = median(spendRate),
    sd_spend = sd(spendRate),
    mean_grad = mean(gradRate),
    median_grad = median(gradRate),
    sd_grad = sd(gradRate),
    correlation = cor(spendRate, gradRate)
  )

count(univData, division)

summaryStats <- univData %>%
  group_by(division) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_spend = mean(spendRate),
    median_spend = median(spendRate),
    sd_spend = sd(spendRate),
    mean_grad = mean(gradRate),
    median_grad = median(gradRate),
    sd_grad = sd(gradRate),
    correlation = cor(spendRate, gradRate)
  )
summaryStats
write_csv(summaryStats, "../Output/Tables/01_summary_stats_by_division.csv")

p1 <- ggplot(univData, aes(spendRate, gradRate, color = division)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) + scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Athletic Spending Share", y = "6-year Graduation Rate",
       color = "Division",
       title = "Athletic Spending Share vs. Graduation Rate by Division")
p1
ggsave("../Output/Plots/01_scatter_main.png", p1, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggplot(univData, aes(spendRate, gradRate)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent) +scale_y_continuous(labels = percent) +
  labs(x = "Athletic Spending Share",
       y = "6-year Graduation Rate",
       title = "Athletic Spending Share vs. Graduation Rate")

p2 <- ggplot(univData, aes(x = division, y = spendRate)) +
  geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "Athletic spending / Total expenses", x = NULL)
p2
ggsave("../Output/Plots/02_boxplot_spending.png", p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)


p3 <- ggplot(univData, aes(x = division, y = gradRate)) +
  geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
  labs(y = "6-year Graduation Rate", x = NULL)
p3
ggsave("../Output/Plots/03_boxplot_gradrate.png", p3, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)


# Coefficient plot: within-division slopes with 95% CI

coef_data <- univData %>%
  group_by(division) %>%
  group_modify(~ tidy(lm(gradRate ~ spendRate, data = .x), conf.int = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(term == "spendRate")

write_csv(coef_data, "../Output/Tables/02_within_division_regressions.csv")

p4 <- ggplot(coef_data, aes(x = estimate, y = division, color = division)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high), height = 0, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  labs(x = "Slope: Δ Graduation Rate per Unit Δ in Spending Share", y = NULL,
       title = "Within-Division Regression Slopes (95% Confidence Interval)") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "none")
p4
ggsave("../Output/Plots/04_coefficient_plot.png", p4, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)


```

# Tests
```{r}
univData %>%
  group_by(division) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(gradRate ~ spendRate, data = .))) %>%
  filter(term == "spendRate")

univData %>%
  group_by(division) %>%
  do(glance(lm(gradRate ~ spendRate, data = .)))

# Pooled
mod_pooled <- lm(gradRate ~ spendRate, data = univData)
summary(mod_pooled)

# Additive model: same slope, different intercepts by division
mod_additive <- lm(gradRate ~ spendRate + division, data = univData)
summary(mod_additive)

# Interaction model: slopes differ by division  
mod_interaction <- lm(gradRate ~ spendRate * division, data = univData)
summary(mod_interaction)

# 03: model comparison via glance
modelComparison <- bind_rows(
  glance(mod_pooled)      %>% mutate(model = "pooled", .before = 1),
  glance(mod_additive)    %>% mutate(model = "additive", .before = 1),
  glance(mod_interaction) %>% mutate(model = "interaction", .before = 1)
)
write_csv(modelComparison, "../Output/Tables/03_model_comparison.csv")



# F-test: do the slopes actually differ across divisions?
ftest <- tidy(anova(mod_additive, mod_interaction))
ftest
write_csv(ftest, "../Output/Tables/04_ftest_additive_vs_interaction.csv")

# One-way ANOVAs for completeness
summary(aov(gradRate ~ division, data = univData))
summary(aov(spendRate ~ division, data = univData))

write_csv(tidy(aov(gradRate ~ division, data = univData)),  "../Output/Tables/05a_anova_gradrate_by_division.csv")
write_csv(tidy(aov(spendRate ~ division, data = univData)), "../Output/Tables/05b_anova_spendrate_by_division.csv")

png("../Output/Plots/06_diagnostic_plots.png", width = 2400, height = 1800, res = 300)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(mod_interaction)
dev.off()
```
